title: Copilot automatic reads respect the publication cadence
description: Headless protocol proof through an authenticated private WebSocket endpoint. Real owning-store clear writes, original held reply bytes and normal server publication timing exercise the production cache. No UI, provider or cache-value injection.

proofTargets.claim: The production cache reaches actual chat.clear state and its final resource revision.
A real held reply is revalidated against newer owning-store publications.
Automatic reads respect the declared copilot interval across a slow-reply boundary.
The observed connection stays quiet after writes stop and never invokes provider commands.

prove.intent: Exercise actual copilot writes and observed reads across a held reply.

realWriterState.intent: Read actual cleared state with the final owning-store revision.

heldReplyRevalidated.intent: A real held reply is revalidated against newer owning-store publications.

boundedAutomaticReads.intent: Bound automatic reads across the slow-reply boundary.

idleQuiet.intent: Stay idle after writes stop, with no provider commands.
